allowed_scope: After exact local preregistration commit: one worker runs the eight frozen in-memory comparison cases, then exactly one report over the existing 514 compact records. No rerun of the failed source stage, rescore, new sample, original stream or selected numerical input read.

checks.model_and_official_identities: Same frozen identity hashes as the source registration; this reviewer did not read model bytes. Execution verify explicitly hashes bytes without loading or scoring.
checks.comparison: Only exact int object keys become str keys. Reject normalized-key collisions, non-JSON values, unsupported key types and nonfinite floats. Keep all fields, list order, scalar value and int/float/bool distinctions; no tolerance or field omission.
checks.comparison_boundary: SHA-bound already-parsed JSON values produced by the existing writer, not an arbitrary external JSON text parser.
checks.minimal_reporting_diff: Original aggregation, coverage, witness selection and data traversal retained. Only strict value comparison, disjoint source/output roots, distinct repair/source freeze bindings and failure-preserving metadata changed.
checks.input_traversal: Uses frozen original manifest/shard readers. Reports from candidate compact once, no selected input arrays, support pickle, original streams or reference compact decode.
checks.ready: Exact committed set must equal all 126 public frozen sources plus current registration, freeze, pre-review, advice and root decision; every Git blob hash is checked.
checks.once_and_deadline: Exclusive started/request/worker/report output markers; no retries. Continuous deadline checked after historical stat and lifecycle writes, before success summary. 110 seconds worker plus cleanup within 120 seconds.
checks.output_isolation: Source and repair output roots must be disjoint. All report writes target new output; source stage acceptance remains false.
checks.history_protection: 6581 inherited/source-stage entries checked by stat; source hashes and exact allowed derived inputs checked separately. Not a fresh byte proof of all historical data.

resolved_pre_review_findings.counterexample: Previously an empty self-reported git_files_sha256 map passed the loop. The current equality check requires the entire 131-file expected set before Git blob validation.
Previously history stat/lifecycle work could finish after the deadline while summary.passed stayed true. The current post-verification check records TimeoutError, writes false and rejects completion.

conclusion: Static execution approval only. Actual regressions, repaired report, process cleanup, preservation and publication remain subject to new execution and independent evidence review. The prior failed stage is not retroactively passed.
